title: Work scheme — composition
question: How should the process stages read on /workscheme? World stays Parchment Atelier.

options.label: Stage Ledger
options.thesis: Ten stages as a single atelier ledger: oversized stage numerals, title, body — like a working drawing index, not a sticky sidebar app.
options.viewport: Headline + short support. First stage fills the reading column with a giant 01; remaining stages stack as ruled ledger rows. No sticky rail.
options.risk: Can feel long if rhythm is flat — needs strong numeral scale contrast.

options.label: Atelier Panel
options.thesis: Left: compact stage index. Right: one large focused stage panel that swaps as you click or scroll — process as a working brief, not a long scroll of equals.
options.viewport: Title band. Two-column: numbered index left; active stage title + body dominate the right panel.
options.risk: Panel swap must stay readable on mobile (stack to accordion).

options.label: Split Process Dialogue
options.lineage: Studio-style chapter and plate dialogue adapted for stages
options.thesis: Stages on the left answer with a quiet parchment plate / number field on the right that tracks the active stage — process as conversation, not a sidebar checklist.
options.viewport: Title. Left column of stages; right sticky giant stage numeral + title echo.
options.risk: Must not copy Studio story content; numbers stay the product signal.

options.label: Re-roll compositions
options.thesis: Deal three fresh structures for the same Parchment Atelier world.
